title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Four Typical Cases of Cracking Down on Counterfeit Agricultural Materials
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Releases Four Typical Cases of Crackdown on Counterfeit Agricultural Materials

To cooperate with the 2010 national special campaign against counterfeit agricultural materials, deter lawbreakers, protect farmers' interests, and promote healthy development of agriculture and rural economy, the Supreme People's Court released four typical cases of crackdown on counterfeit agricultural materials:

I. People v. Wang Mingcheng and Shi Feng — crime of selling counterfeit seeds and illegal business operation

The Shunyi District People's Court of Beijing found through trial: 1. Defendant Wang Mingcheng established Beijing Yafeng Agricultural Development Co., Ltd. in June 2003 and served as its legal representative. Without obtaining a crop seed operation license and beyond the valid area specified in the forest tree seed operation license, Wang Mingcheng, through Beijing Yafeng Company and its branches in Jinan, Nanjing, Xi'an, and elsewhere, purchased crop seeds and forest tree seeds from other sources, repackaged, sub-packaged, self-propagated and then packaged the seeds, or directly sold them in bulk form. From 2003 to January 2006, Wang Mingcheng sold through the above means seven categories of seeds, including rice, wheat, beans, sorghum, corn, millet, and cotton, totaling over RMB 1,620,000, sold grape seedlings totaling over RMB 1,380,000, and sold other seeds totaling over RMB 2,340,000; 2. From September 2003 to January 2006, defendant Wang Mingcheng repeatedly purchased cotton seeds from other companies or individuals, and arranged for personnel to repackage the purchased cotton seeds into so-called Yafeng series "S80" cotton seeds, or propagate the purchased cotton seeds and package them into "S80" cotton seeds. This cotton seed name was fabricated by Wang Mingcheng himself and had not undergone examination and approval. In early 2004, farmer Chen Chunyue from Dongtai City, Jiangsu Province contacted the Beijing Yafeng Company Jinan Sales Office, which was headed by defendant Shi Feng, regarding seed purchase. Knowing that "S80" was counterfeit seeds, Shi Feng still sold a total of 1,320 bags of "S80" cotton seeds to Chen Chunyue at a total price of RMB 29,340. Chen Chunyue kept a portion of the purchased cotton seeds for his own planting and resold most at a markup to multiple cotton growers in Dongtai City. After planting, the growers found that the growth of "S80" cotton did not match the variety label, and it was not suitable for planting in Dongtai City. Appraisal confirmed that over 1,800 mu of "S80" cotton seeds were planted locally, with losses exceeding RMB 900,000.

The Shunyi District People's Court sentenced defendant Wang Mingcheng to four years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 3,000,000 for the crime of illegal business operation, and to ten years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit seeds, deciding to execute a combined sentence of 13 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 3,050,000; sentenced defendant Shi Feng to eight years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 50,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit seeds. After the judgment was pronounced, defendants Wang Mingcheng and Shi Feng refused to accept and appealed. The Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court, after trial, lawfully dismissed the appeals of Wang Mingcheng and Shi Feng and affirmed the original judgment.

II. People v. Kong Yankun — crime of selling counterfeit fertilizer

The First People's Court of Dongguan, Guangdong Province found through trial: Between February 2006 and May 2007, knowing that the "Sinofert" brand potassium chloride fertilizer he sold was counterfeit fertilizer, Kong Yankun sold 91 tons of counterfeit "Sinofert" potassium chloride fertilizer at prices ranging from RMB 2,000 to 2,200 per ton to banana grower Liang Weijiang of Sanshui District, Foshan City. Liang Weijiang applied the purchased counterfeit fertilizer on the 867 mu of banana fields he had contracted, causing the banana plants to show symptoms such as yellowing leaves, broken flower buds, and seedling necrosis, with a yield reduction of approximately 30% and economic losses of over RMB 2,090,000.

The First People's Court of Dongguan sentenced defendant Kong Yankun to seven years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit fertilizer. After the judgment was pronounced, defendant Kong Yankun refused to accept and appealed. The Dongguan Intermediate People's Court, after trial, lawfully dismissed the appeal of Kong Yankun and affirmed the original judgment.

III. People v. Yu Changjiu — crime of selling counterfeit seeds

The Dehui City People's Court of Jilin Province found through trial: Knowing that the Yedan 19 corn seeds he sold were counterfeit seeds, defendant Yu Changjiu sold 24,374 jin of such seeds in Dehui City in February and March 2008, causing over 600 farming households in the city to suffer a yield reduction of approximately 1,170,000 kilograms, resulting in economic losses of approximately RMB 1,750,000.

The Dehui City People's Court sentenced defendant Yu Changjiu to eight years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 200,000 for the crime of selling counterfeit seeds. After the judgment was pronounced, defendant Yu Changjiu refused to accept and appealed. The Changchun Intermediate People's Court of Jilin Province, after trial, lawfully dismissed the appeal of Yu Changjiu and affirmed the original judgment.

IV. People v. Wang Zhangjiu — crime of producing and selling counterfeit pesticide

The Xi'an Intermediate People's Court of Shaanxi Province found through trial: In March 2008, defendant Wang Zhangjiu misappropriated the pesticide registration number, production approval certificate number, and product implementation standard of the "Sencaojing" herbicide produced by Xi'an Modern Pesticide Science and Technology Co., Ltd., unauthorizedly organized the production of a herbicide named "Yuanding No. 1" specifically for vineyards, and falsified the test report. On March 25, 2008, Wang Zhangjiu sold 80 cases (1,000 kg in total) of "Yuanding No. 1" vineyard-specific herbicide to Xinjiang Fengda Kailai Biotechnology Co., Ltd. for RMB 120,000. Fengda Kailai Company sold 60 cases of the herbicide to some grape growers in Shihezi City and Turpan Prefecture of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region. After use, the growers observed symptoms such as yellowing and shriveling of grape leaves, small fruit grains, and extensive root necrosis, leading to severe yield reduction or even total crop failure, causing direct economic losses of over RMB 1,260,000.

The Xi'an Intermediate People's Court sentenced defendant Wang Zhangjiu to eight years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 60,000 for the crime of producing and selling counterfeit pesticides. After the judgment was pronounced, defendant Wang Zhangjiu refused to accept and appealed. The Shaanxi High People's Court, after trial, lawfully dismissed the appeal of Wang Zhangjiu and affirmed the original judgment.
